text:
Ava (People Ops): Final reminder — attestation freeze starts in 72 hours. All SOC2/ISO artifacts must be uploaded and tagged (`soc2:evidence` or `iso:attestation`) before the freeze. If you need an exception, file it now using the template and include a mitigation plan. :warning:

Jon (Security): Note for teams running Dedicated: include the most recent vulnerability scan summary and the patch window evidence. Redacted CVEs ok.

Priya (Data Privacy): Privacy checklist: data maps, retention justification, and any DPIA attachments for extended retention. If your doc contains PII, upload a redacted version + the redaction log.

Marco (Eng): Quick ops note — our rollout logs are large. Will upload an index file pointing to redacted slices. Is that acceptable?

Jon (Security): Yes, index + slices is fine. Make sure slices contain at least one end-to-end trace and the deployment manifest.

Ava (People Ops): Exception process reminder: use `attestation-exception-template.md` (Audit Toolkit). Required fields: owner, scope, duration, risk mitigation, approver. Post the filled template to Confluence and paste the link here so compliance can triage.

Priya (Data Privacy): Contractors: confirm NDAs for any non-employee with production access. If not on file, they will be excluded from scope — please list names now.

evidence-bot: Automated snapshot: 22 teams complete, 6 teams partial, 3 exception requests pending approval. Dashboard: https://redwood.internal/evidence (internal). Reminder scheduled 24h before freeze.

Ava (People Ops): We'll run a short triage at 10:00 AM PT tomorrow for anyone with blockers. Bring Confluence links and the exception template if requesting extra time. Thanks everyone for the push! :clap:
